facts.text: The party must bring Warwick the smith metal from the Dwarven mine. Warwick, out of metal since the dragon appeared, holds Sir Phidipaldi's lyre and the party's plate armor as collateral until then.
The party must return Warwick's mithril chain shirt, lent for the Dwarven mine trip. Ingrid says it was his grandfather's armor and he never let her touch it.
Wayman wears Warwick's mithril chain shirt, on loan, over his leather armor; it greatly improves his protection and halves damage from magic weapons and spells.
A cave-in seals the Dwarven mine entrance, blocking access to the metal owed to Warwick. It looks natural and can be dug through; Dunk has started breaking into it, uncovering a dead dwarf.
